notes: Verified against harmony-nutri-dev.myshopify.com on the Basic plan with Admin API version 2026-04.
Pass the ShopifyQL query through the GraphQL $q variable.
Rows are objects keyed by column name.
Metrics are pre-aggregated; do not wrap them in sum(), count(), or avg().
VISUALIZE is not supported through the GraphQL API.

sales.description: Default analytics dataset on Basic. Use for revenue, orders, customer counts, product analytics, and most report-style questions.

sessions.description: Traffic and attribution dataset on Basic.

customers.description: Customer listing and spend analytics. More constrained than sales on Basic. customer_email must appear in GROUP BY when grouping by other dimensions.

payment_attempts.description: Very limited on Basic but partially usable.

inventory.description: Accepted as a dataset target but no working metrics were verified on Basic. Treat as unavailable for practical reporting.

topics.title: Verified ShopifyQL overview
topics.description: ShopifyQL is an aggregated analytics language executed through the GraphQL shopifyqlQuery field. The GraphQL API does not support VISUALIZE.

topics.title: Verified keyword order
topics.description: Use FROM then SHOW, then WHERE, GROUP BY, TIMESERIES, SINCE, UNTIL, DURING, COMPARE TO, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, WITH.

topics.title: Time filtering
topics.description: Use SINCE and UNTIL for relative or absolute dates, DURING for named ranges, and COMPARE TO for period comparisons.

topics.title: Broken official-doc datasets
topics.description: On the tested Basic-plan GraphQL API, products and orders are not valid FROM datasets. Use sales for aggregate reporting instead.

topics.title: WHERE and HAVING
topics.description: WHERE filters dimensions before aggregation. HAVING filters metrics after aggregation.

topics.title: TIMESERIES
topics.description: TIMESERIES groups by time, replaces GROUP BY for the time dimension, and fills missing buckets with zeros.

topics.title: WITH modifiers
topics.description: Only one WITH clause is valid. Supported modifiers include TOTALS, GROUP_TOTALS, PERCENT_CHANGE, CUMULATIVE_VALUES, CURRENCY, and TIMEZONE.

topics.title: Metafields
topics.description: Metafields can be used in WHERE, GROUP BY, and SHOW with the format owner_type.metafields.namespace.key.

topics.title: Critical gotchas
topics.description: SHOW * is invalid, metrics are pre-aggregated, many documented columns fail on Basic, and MATCHES is not usable in the tested Basic-plan GraphQL setup.
